deposits.wiki_article: Semantic Physics: A Stratified, Operative Discipline is the top-of-lattice consolidation document for the discipline of semantic physics. It surveys fourteen independent frameworks that emerged in 2024-2026, proposes a three-scale (micro/meso/macro) and six-modality stratification, identifies the bridge operators connecting scales, and claims the mesoscale, macro, and operative modalities as the sustained contribution of the Semantic Economy Institute.
